description: Use this when the user asks which teams allow the most or fewest to a position ('best matchups for centers', 'defenses vs TE'). Returns what each NBA or NFL team allows per game to a position group (NBA: G, F, C, with pace rank; NFL: QB, RB, WR, TE), each number as [value, league rank] (1 = allows the most). Without `position` the NBA answer lists each group's ten softest teams (`data_more` counts the rest) and the NFL's the softest half: pass `position` for every team, as for the fewest allowed. Window 'recent' (last 10 games) needs Pro. Not for one player's matchup (player_profile's next game).

season.description: Optional season year. Defaults to the current season.

window.description: Sample window: "season" (free) or "recent" (last 10 games, requires Pro).
